title: Add CSV rerun safe dashboard
summary: Added a backend-owned CSV rerun safe dashboard with a read-only preview route, scoped execution controls, scoped CSV materialization for dry-run/live starts, result evidence, and WebView operator rendering.
reason: The Launch CSV Rerun tab exposed only sparse inputs. Operators needed bounded CSV inspection, recent CSV selection, row/scope evidence, and explicit safe-policy gating while keeping destructive policies blocked.
behavior_before: Plan CSV Rerun submitted the process-launch path, and the Launch rerun tab had only CSV path and mode fields. Scope filtering, row summaries, recent CSV candidates, backend preview evidence, and rerun history were not available.
behavior_after: Plan CSV Rerun calls POST /api/rerun/preview and performs no scoped CSV or process-launch writes. Dry-run/live starts still require copy/keep/park; when scope filters narrow rows, the backend writes a scoped CSV under State/Rerun/ScopedCsv after launch locks and active-work checks pass, then launches the existing rerun process against that scoped CSV.
tests_added: tests/python/desktop/test_api_command_contracts.py updated for strict rerun preview/start payloads
tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_process_launch.py updated for plan no-write and scoped CSV launch path
tests/python/desktop/test_application_facade_web_static_launch.py updated for rerun dashboard DOM/API coverage
tests/webview/test_webview_launch_command_buttons_smoke.py updated for rerun scope payload collection
manual_validation: node --check for touched WebView JS/MJS files passed.
python -m unittest selected rerun facade, Launch static, and Tauri scaffold tests -q passed: 97 tests.
rollback_plan: Remove /api/rerun/preview from the route maps/contracts, revert rerun_preview.py and the rerun facade scoped CSV path changes, restore the Launch rerun tab to its previous sparse controls, regenerate WebView generated baselines/summaries, and rerun the focused rerun/API/WebView tests.
